$comment: Generated by scripts/collect-slots.mjs from a live harness slot-tree snapshot. Purpose text is the harness's own seat description, verbatim.

seats.name: root
seats.purpose: The built-in render-tree root hole (seeded by SlotCore): the one slot the shell itself renders, and the ancestor of every other seat.

seats.name: shell.overlay
seats.purpose: Frame-wide floating layer, above every column and outside their scroll containers.

seats.name: shell.quota-notice
seats.purpose: Frame-wide quota notice chain.

seats.name: main
seats.purpose: Central panel selected by sidebar entry id.
seats.keyDomain: open: any string the owner dispatches (no compile-time key set), already taken: conversation

seats.name: plugins.bundle.config
seats.purpose: A bundle's own configuration, keyed by the bundle's package name and rendered on the bundle's page between its description and its rows (`view: 'page'` only).
seats.keyDomain: open: any string the owner dispatches (no compile-time key set), already taken: @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle

seats.name: plugins.item
seats.purpose: One official plugin the Plugins page lists in its Official group after the official bundles: `label` is the card's title and `order` its place.

seats.name: plugins.bundle.activation
seats.purpose: Optional guidance after the user enables a bundle from the list, keyed by npm package name.
seats.keyDomain: open: any string the owner dispatches (no compile-time key set), already taken: @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle

seats.name: plugins.row.config
seats.purpose: The configuration of one row a bundle declares, keyed by `<package name>#<row id>` with the row id as the bundle's patch declares it: the row on the bundle's page gains a configure control that opens the entry's page, headed by the plugin's display title and description.
seats.keyDomain: open: any string the owner dispatches (no compile-time key set), none are taken yet

seats.name: plugins.detail.actions
seats.purpose: Controls at the head of a detail page, before the page's own switch and uninstall, rendered with the page's subject.

seats.name: plugins.detail.badge
seats.purpose: Tags beside a detail page's title, after the version, beta, and problem tags the page draws itself, rendered with the page's subject.

seats.name: plugins.detail.section
seats.purpose: Sections under a detail page's own content: after the rows on a bundle's page, after the configuration on a row's or an official plugin's page.

seats.name: main.conversation
seats.purpose: Conversation shell beneath its root-scoped main-panel entry.

seats.name: conversation.header
seats.purpose: Resident navigation container, including when no Session is selected.

seats.name: conversation.header.leading
seats.purpose: Global navigation before the Session title, available without a Session.

seats.name: conversation.session.header
seats.purpose: Strict per-Session title, actions, and View navigation.

seats.name: conversation.session.header.utilities
seats.purpose: Right-aligned Session utilities in ascending order.

seats.name: conversation.session.header.actions
seats.purpose: Title-adjacent Session actions in ascending order.

seats.name: conversation.session.header.corner
seats.purpose: The header's far-right corner, past the utilities' edge and into the header's own padding, for one control.

seats.name: conversation.session.header.lineage
seats.purpose: Optional replacement for one Session breadcrumb title.

seats.name: sidebar
seats.purpose: The whole left column.

seats.name: sidebar.brand.mark
seats.purpose: Brand mark rendered in the expanded brand row and collapsed rail.

seats.name: sidebar.footer.action
seats.purpose: Optional actions beside Settings at the sidebar foot.

seats.name: sidebar.toggle.badge
seats.purpose: Non-interactive notification inside the collapsed sidebar expand button.

seats.name: sidebar.settings
seats.purpose: The settings seat at the sidebar foot.

seats.name: settings.section
seats.purpose: One settings page per list entry.

seats.name: settings.general.item
seats.purpose: One preference row inside the General section — the additive seat for a single setting that needs no page of its own (a whole page is `settings.section`), contributed by the feature plugin that owns the preference (locale → Language, ui-theme → Appearance, ui-conversation → Composer Enter).

seats.name: settings.plugins.tab
seats.purpose: One page inside the Plugins settings section.

seats.name: settings.models.provider-card
seats.purpose: One provider card's adapter extension area, dispatched with `entryKey = settingsNs` on every card that renders a directory row: a saved row's card (its first-run setup posture included) and the add-provider draft card.
seats.keyDomain: open: any string the owner dispatches (no compile-time key set), none are taken yet

seats.name: settings.models.footer
seats.purpose: Ordered extension area after the provider rows and the add controls.

seats.name: settings.onboarding
seats.purpose: Root-scoped onboarding steps contributed by settings features.

seats.name: settings.models.sign-in
seats.purpose: Optional account login choice before the credential editor.

seats.name: settings.trigger
seats.purpose: The sidebar-foot trigger row content: icon + label, supplied as slot content (the accessible name comes from the content — rail state renders the label visually hidden).

seats.name: settings.header
seats.purpose: The panel title text seat.

seats.name: settings.action
seats.purpose: Optional actions rendered in the content-column header before Close.

seats.name: settings.close
seats.purpose: The close button's visually-hidden label text (the button itself — icon, geometry, focus — is shell chrome).

seats.name: settings.launcher
seats.purpose: Optional sidebar account launcher; opens the shell-owned settings panel.

seats.name: sidebar.workspaces
seats.purpose: The workspace/session browsing region: section header, search, the grouped/flat session list, and every workspace dialog.

seats.name: sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item
seats.purpose: The rows of one Session's "..." menu, in ascending `order`.

seats.name: sidebar.workspaces.session.row.action
seats.purpose: The hover buttons at the end of one Session row, in ascending `order`, after the "..." menu trigger.

seats.name: sidebar.workspaces.directoryFlow
seats.purpose: Directory-flow hole under the sidebar browsing region (declared by the WorkspaceBrowser entry).

seats.name: sidebar.session.row.leading
seats.purpose: Leading decoration of one Session row, in the 16px cell before the title that the row's own state dot otherwise occupies.

seats.name: sidebar.session.row.hover
seats.purpose: Section of the Session row's hover card between its relative time and its trailing status line.

seats.name: sidebar.panellist
seats.purpose: Global panel icons.

seats.name: sidebar.brand.name
seats.purpose: Brand name rendered beside the expanded mark.

seats.name: rightbar
seats.purpose: The right column: a track the centre makes room for, or nothing.

seats.name: rightbar.session
seats.purpose: Session content selected by the root-scoped right Sidebar controller.

seats.name: sidebar.right.pane.tab
seats.purpose: One tab's body, dispatched with the `id` of the type in force for `tab.kind`.
seats.keyDomain: open: any string the owner dispatches (no compile-time key set), none are taken yet

seats.name: sidebar.right.tab.guide.entry
seats.purpose: One provider's guide card, with the standard card as the owner's fallback.
seats.keyDomain: open: any string the owner dispatches (no compile-time key set), none are taken yet

seats.name: sidebar.right.tab.guide
seats.purpose: The guide tab's body.

seats.name: sidebar.right.tab.files.actions
seats.purpose: Workspace directory actions after the file tree's reload control.

seats.name: sidebar.right.tab.document.actions
seats.purpose: Header toolbar contributions acting on the previewed file, rendered after the preview's own controls once the file's Host path is known.

seats.name: sidebar.right.tab.document.unpreviewable
seats.purpose: Empty-state contributions for a file this preview cannot render, offered where Retry would stand once the file's Host path is known.

seats.name: deliverables.review.file.actions
seats.purpose: The same file actions owned by a changed-file review tab.

seats.name: sidebar.right.tab.document
seats.purpose: Document body selected by a registered implementation id.
seats.keyDomain: open: any string the owner dispatches (no compile-time key set), none are taken yet

seats.name: sidebar.right.tab.document.office.pdf
seats.purpose: PDF presentation supplied with Office-owned converted bytes.
seats.keyDomain: open: any string the owner dispatches (no compile-time key set), none are taken yet

seats.name: sidebar.right.tab.document.action
seats.purpose: Renderer-specific controls before the document toolbar's reload button.
seats.keyDomain: open: any string the owner dispatches (no compile-time key set), none are taken yet

seats.name: sidebar.chat.conversation
seats.purpose: Session-scoped Conversation occurrence hosted by one Sidebar chat tab.

seats.name: sidebar.right.pane.tab.title
seats.purpose: A tab's title as its chip (and a floating panel's header) shows it, dispatched with the same key and information hook as the body.
seats.keyDomain: open: any string the owner dispatches (no compile-time key set), none are taken yet

seats.name: sidebar.right.tab.menu.item
seats.purpose: Extra items at the end of one tab's actions menu, in registration order.

seats.name: shell.leading
seats.purpose: Window-chrome seat at the frame's top-left, over every main panel.

seats.name: conversation.composer
seats.purpose: Selector-routed replacements for the current Session's resident composer.

seats.name: conversation.approval.detail
seats.purpose: Optional detail for the Tool call correlated with an approval request.

seats.name: conversation.plan-review.actions
seats.purpose: Actions for the exact plan under review; approval remains with the question composer.

seats.name: conversation.input.dock
seats.purpose: Full-width entries above the composer card.

seats.name: conversation.hero.workspace
seats.purpose: Workspace picker shown by the blank-session Hero.

seats.name: conversation.hero.workspace.directoryFlow
seats.purpose: Directory-flow hole under the conversation empty-state picker (declared by the WorkspacePicker entry).

seats.name: conversation.session
seats.purpose: Strict per-Session Conversation body.

seats.name: conversation.view
seats.purpose: Registered Conversation target Views, rendered one at a time.

seats.name: conversation.chat.node
seats.purpose: Final Chat node renderer, keyed by `ChatNodeKind`.
seats.keyDomain: fixed by the owner's key table { [Kind in ChatNodeKind]: { node: ChatNode<Kind> } }, already taken: assistant-step, command, command-input, compaction, context, manual-compaction, model-retry, question-reply, steering, system-prompt, tool-call, turn-error, turn-max-tokens, turn-process, turn-tail, turn-trigger, unknown, user, workflow-run

seats.name: tool.call.toolview
seats.purpose: Keyed Tool call view dispatched by wire Tool name.
seats.keyDomain: open: any string the owner dispatches (no compile-time key set), already taken: ask_user_question, bash, cordis_define, cordis_inspect_list, cordis_inspect_query, cordis_inspect_self, cordis_run, cordis_stop, cordis_undefine, create_goal, edit, get_goal, glob, grep, interrupt_agent, job_kill, job_list, job_output, list_agents, list_subagent_models, lsp, present, ralph, read, read_image, schedule_create, schedule_delete, schedule_list, schedule_update, send_message, session_event_read, session_event_search, session_event_trace, session_search, session_trace, skill, spawn_teammate, subagent, team_task_create, team_task_get, team_task_list, team_task_update, terminal_close, terminal_list, terminal_open, terminal_read, terminal_signal, todo_write, update_goal, wait_agent, web_fetch, web_search, workflow, write

seats.name: tool.call.images
seats.purpose: Durable images of a settled image-bearing Tool call, rendered through the attachment presentation plugin.

seats.name: tool.view.cordis
seats.purpose: Interactive Package-owned region rendered inside the latest eligible `cordis_run` card in the conversation flow.
seats.keyDomain: fixed by the dynamic Client Guard

allowedKeys.description: The only accepted key. The Guard binds it to this Package's pluginId and packageId.

seats.name: conversation.chat.assistant-actions
seats.purpose: Ordered actions for one finalized assistant message.

seats.name: conversation.chat.commandview
seats.purpose: Command row keyed by the command name.
seats.keyDomain: open: any string the owner dispatches (no compile-time key set), none are taken yet

seats.name: conversation.chat.turnTail
seats.purpose: Ordered feature contributions before a completed Turn's action row.

seats.name: deliverables.file.actions
seats.purpose: Open one file through its authorized Session event coordinates.

seats.name: conversation.message.images
seats.purpose: Renderer for one consecutive group of durable message images.

seats.name: conversation.trajectory.images
seats.purpose: Renderer for one group of durable record images in the Trajectory ledger.

seats.name: conversation.composer.bar
seats.purpose: Resident composer body, including the no-Session inert state.

seats.name: conversation.composer.dock
seats.purpose: Ambient entries below the composer card.

seats.name: conversation.input.overlay
seats.purpose: Floating entries rendered inside the resident composer card.

seats.name: conversation.input.attachments
seats.purpose: Optional draft-attachment rail and drop target.

seats.name: conversation.input.permission
seats.purpose: Current-session permission control inside the composer tool row.

seats.name: conversation.input.left
seats.purpose: Compact controls at the left of the composer tool row.

seats.name: conversation.input.plan
seats.purpose: Plan control inside the composer tool row.

seats.name: conversation.input.right
seats.purpose: Compact controls before the composer submit action.

seats.name: conversation.input.model
seats.purpose: Model selector inside the composer tool row.

seats.name: conversation.input.activity
seats.purpose: Compact action after the model selector; it can expand across the toolbar while retaining the editor and submit action.

seats.name: conversation.hero.brand.mark
seats.purpose: Brand mark shown before the blank-session headline.

seats.name: conversation.hero.agentPreset
seats.purpose: Agent-preset control staged for a New Session.
